1. The post copy

The release gives AI no job description.

On October 14th Lockheed Martin said Hadrian will bring a highly automated 24 machine cell to the Grand Prairie plant. A state filing puts the plant in Dallas County.

Announced. A cell expected in early 2027, to be run by Lockheed's own workforce. A $300 million investment in the plant. Plans for 2,000 Texas jobs, the company's own statewide figure.

Already done, by Lockheed's count. More than 30 machines added in a few months. The plant made 250,000 parts in 2025.

Hadrian says its own factories combine process engineering, AI and robotics. It says its software Opus "interprets legacy designs and automates manufacturing and inspection". Neither statement says what AI would do in this cell.

The deck runs from a finished part to 24 empty bays.

How many of the cell's 24 machines will use AI?

#GrandPrairie #DallasCounty #Hadrian

The machine changed itself

  • The machine shop is now in the kit
    A full detail CNC pendant (glass screen, recessed keys, knurled handwheel, override knobs, e-stop), a machining centre with curled chips, a vise, a part and an empty bay in assets/js/kit/industry.js. This answers no. 56's calculator pendant, named by every judge in every round. Proven in the engine, today's frames unchanged.
  • depth_floor reads a TXT.interior room as a ground
    Nos. 55 and 56 laid a second floor under all 11 room frames to pass it, and the two floors z-fought.
  • The detail floor was not loosened
    Measured, it already asks less of a dark plate. Its failure message now refuses the ruled grid the judges called graph paper on three decks and names the cure.
  • The arsenal states TXT.stage's unit
    Nos. 54 and 56 passed behind and depth as metres; they are fractions of the subject's distance.
  • For a maintainer, in UPGRADE_BACKLOG.md
    An engine fix so a closed room stops taking the sky's navy (nos. 51 and 56), an owner decision on a cheaper type-only audition reading (nos. 54 to 56 spent four to nine readings), a wall anchor in the kit registry, a stage unit warning and one GATE_LESSONS entry. Deferred: the kit person at repeat 2, since today's deck renders from it.

Notes

The record. 179 items re-verified: 106 stamped by the diff, 21 more confirmed by hand and 12 given their own movement line. tx-2026-0003 and tx-2026-0076's filing counts moved, the Texas Animal Health Commission now counts 44 screwworm premises (tx-2026-0218), and Dallas's October 19th briefing on its brush truck cameras went into tx-2026-0179. Admitted: tx-2026-0225, Lockheed Martin bringing Hadrian's 24 machine cell into its Grand Prairie plant, on the company's release and a TDLR filing that names Dallas County. Held: nothing else new; the other leads were journalism only or already in the record. Selection. The Dallas brush truck cameras were refused by the thirty day rule (carousel no. 31). Lockheed's release was chosen for its measured scale and because the sources themselves carry the turn: Hadrian says its own factories combine AI and robotics, and the release never says what AI would do in this cell. The deck. Nine rendered frames in the lastLight machine shop. It ships at the round cap at 6.90, 1.10 under the 8.0 top rung, no hard fail in any round (6.75, 6.77, 6.90). The judges' standing charges: frame 8's pendant reads as a calculator on a navy field, frame 3's tray reads as a keyboard at feed size, frame 2's slab as graph paper. The copywriter and the integrity judge caught and fixed real fact slips: slide 6's "24 more" and slide 8's assumption of AI, and the caption's "AI powered" for Hadrian's factories, now c15's own words. Permissions, interim reading at Phase 17: prompt_audit measured 1,847 calls and 71 whose permission decision took longer than an auto-approval (26 subagent spawns, 44 Bash calls and one SendMessage, the longest 30.3 s on a subagent spawn), each released without a refusal. The no-stall hook was armed at 05:07:32 UTC, judged the session unattended from session start (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0, and the host's value was 0) and refused nothing. The reading that counts is taken before the draft.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
